Metadata.title: AnimaForge — AI text editing
Metadata.description: An AI-assisted workspace for text editing

Home.title: Novel projects
Home.description: Organize worlds, characters, and chapters, then create with AI using complete context.

Settings.title: Settings
Settings.localKeys: Keys are stored only in the local database
Settings.servicesDescription: Manage OpenAI- and Anthropic-compatible services and models.
Settings.generalDescription: Manage interface, AI output, and character chat preferences.
Settings.noServicesDescription: Add a service and model to start generating.
Settings.tasksDescription: Configure a global fallback plus the model and reply length for each task. Projects can override these settings.
Settings.globalDefaultModelDescription: Used as the fallback when a task has no model configured.
Settings.promptsDescription: Manage the reviewers and prompts used for project reviews.
Settings.noReviewersDescription: Add a reviewer to evaluate projects from a distinct perspective.
Settings.reviewerPromptPlaceholder: Describe the review perspective, priorities, and feedback style…
Settings.deleteReviewerDescription: “{name}” will be removed from the available reviewers. Existing reviews are unaffected.
Settings.interfaceLanguageDescription: Controls application menus, labels, and error messages. It does not affect AI output.
Settings.outputLanguageDescription: Enter any language name. When blank, no output-language instruction is sent to the model.
Settings.outputLanguageExample: For example: English, Simplified Chinese, Japanese
Settings.summaryDescription: Generates chapter synopses, block synopses, and checkpoint summaries.
Settings.assistantDescription: Supports project planning, character creation, and attachment analysis.
Settings.chatDescription: Used for solo and group character chats with automatic speaker selection.
Settings.reviewDescription: Generates project reviews from different reviewer perspectives.
Settings.revisionPlanDescription: Generates a global Markdown revision blueprint from a review and source manuscript.
Settings.revisionExecutionDescription: Generates revised prose window by window from an approved blueprint.
Settings.translationBlueprintDescription: Analyzes long source files in segments and creates a global translation blueprint.
Settings.translationDraftDescription: Produces a base translation window by window under the blueprint.
Settings.translationProofreadDescription: Corrects grammar, translationese, mistranslations, omissions, and additions.
Settings.translationFidelityDescription: Audits context, details, voice, and terminology consistency.
Settings.translationPolishDescription: Performs literary polishing while preserving content and format.
Settings.translationConcurrencyDescription: Limits simultaneous model calls; projects rotate between windows.
Settings.translationWindowSizeDescription: Controls source windows for all translation projects. Automatic mode uses the safe capacity of every enabled stage model.
Settings.revisionWindowSizeDescription: Controls source windows during novel revision execution. Started tasks keep their original windows.
Settings.automaticWindowSizeHint: Calculated from model context, prompt content, and output reserve, with an 8K-token default quality ceiling.
Settings.characterChatMaxConsecutiveRepliesDescri: Limits total non-user character replies without a user turn. Control returns to the user at the limit.
Settings.name: Name
Settings.addModelDescription: The model ID is sent to the service unchanged. The custom request body is merged into every request.
Settings.tokenPricesDescription: Leave all prices blank to mark the model unpriced. Blank cache prices fall back to the input price.
Settings.deleteDescription: “{name}” will be permanently deleted. Any task defaults that reference it must be selected again.
